title: Looking for AppSec champions to lead community sessions for OWASP OASIS.
description: This is a community announcement seeking volunteers to lead sessions for OWASP OASIS, an open-source security community focused on validating vulnerability fixes in open-source projects. The initiative aims to build a collaborative environment for AppSec practitioners to gain practical experience and help secure open source software.

aiSummary: OWASP OASIS is recruiting volunteer leaders to facilitate community sessions such as office hours, onboarding, and collaborative validation of proposed vulnerability fixes in open-source projects. The goal is to foster a supportive community where members can teach each other and gain hands-on application security experience. This announcement does not describe a security vulnerability or threat but rather a community engagement effort.
aiImpact: There is no direct security impact or vulnerability described. This is a community-building initiative intended to improve open-source security through collaborative validation and education.
